calibration_ceilings.note: Highest index each saved correction can emit. Computed from the calibrator, not applied as a clip. A later county or region map can raise a ceiling. Read this object instead of hardcoding one.

band_override_reason.posted_warning: posting_status warning forces the band to Very Likely Unsafe on every lead; neptune_index stays the calibrated number
band_override_reason.closure: posting_status closure forces the band to Very Likely Unsafe on every lead; neptune_index stays the calibrated number
band_override_reason.empty: the band is the matching row of config/neptune_index_bands.json
